criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Build a suitable neural-network regression model; document architecture, settings and reproducibility.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Encode and scale appropriately, fit preprocessing on training data only, and use validation or suitable regularization.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate with held-out data, compare train/validation behaviour and discuss overfitting and error patterns.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare the neural network and selected best ML model on identical held-out examples using consistent metrics.

criteria.name: NLP Implementation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Define and demonstrate a valid NLP task using customer reviews; report appropriate evaluation if labels exist and do not fabricate labels or metrics.
